narration: That figure is invented for this example. A model can invent one exactly the same way.
caption: यह आंकड़ा उदाहरण के लिए गढ़ा गया है। मॉडल भी ऐसे ही गढ़ सकता है।
image_brief: Two identical white cards side by side on dark cloth, each showing a different four digit number, neither card carrying a source line, even overhead light.

narration: It feels right because similar sentences carry similar numbers. That resemblance is the whole basis.
caption: सही लगता है क्योंकि ऐसे वाक्यों में ऐसे ही आंकड़े आते हैं। बस इतना।
image_brief: Several printed product labels pinned in a row on a corkboard, each showing a different but similar four digit rating, one blank label at the end, flat light.

narration: Now count the steps. A three hundred word answer is roughly four hundred tokens.
caption: अब चरण गिनिए: तीन सौ शब्दों का जवाब लगभग चार सौ टोकन होता है।
image_brief: A printed page of continuous prose lying flat, its right margin filled with small pencil tally marks in dense clusters, a worn pencil across the corner, desk light.

narration: Four hundred separate choices, each from fifty thousand candidates. And no review pass afterwards.
caption: चार सौ अलग चुनाव, हर बार पचास हज़ार में से। और दोबारा जाँच नहीं।
image_brief: A long assembly bench with hundreds of identical small parts set in neat rows, the inspection station at the far end of the bench standing empty, cold factory light.

narration: Most of those choices were nearly forced. A few were wide open. Those few carry the risk.
caption: ज़्यादातर चुनाव लगभग तय थे। कुछ खुले थे, और ख़तरा उन्हीं में है।
image_brief: A row of narrow doorways along a corridor, nearly all of them wedged almost shut, two standing wide open with light spilling out, bare floor, low light.

narration: Now the limits, starting with a mistake I nearly walked you into. Watch the arithmetic.
caption: अब सीमाएँ, और पहले वह भूल जो मैं लगभग करा ही चुका था।
image_brief: A pencil calculation on a notepad with one line struck through twice, the eraser end of the pencil worn flat and resting on the page, warm desk light.

narration: Four hundred steps, each ninety five percent reliable. That sounds survivable. Run the multiplication.
caption: चार सौ चरण, हर एक 95 प्रतिशत भरोसेमंद। गुणा करके देखिए।
image_brief: A slip of paper showing a repeated multiplication written out by hand and trailing off into dots, held under a magnet on a metal cabinet door, cool light.

narration: Multiply it out and you get almost nothing. Roughly one chance in a billion.
caption: गुणा करने पर नतीजा लगभग शून्य आता है, अरब में एक जैसा।
image_brief: A single grain of rice placed alone at the centre of a wide empty dark tray, the tray rim catching a thin line of light, everything else bare.

narration: Yet real answers arrive coherent, paragraph after paragraph. So that multiplication model is simply wrong.
caption: फिर भी जवाब जुड़े हुए आते हैं। यानी वह गुणा वाला हिसाब ग़लत है।
image_brief: A finished page of neatly justified prose held flat under a glass paperweight, its edges perfectly aligned, no marks or corrections anywhere, clear daylight.

narration: Most steps are almost forced by grammar. And errors are not independent of each other.
caption: ज़्यादातर चरण व्याकरण से तय होते हैं, और ग़लतियाँ आज़ाद नहीं होतीं।
image_brief: A line of dominoes standing in a groove cut into a wooden plank, unable to fall sideways, one domino tilted against the groove wall, warm raking light.

narration: Second mistake. Believing it looked something up. It did not look anything up. Nowhere.
caption: दूसरी भूल: यह मानना कि उसने कहीं खोजकर बताया। खोजा कुछ नहीं।
image_brief: A library reading desk with its lamp switched off, a closed catalogue volume, and a request slip left blank on the blotter, chair pushed in, dim evening light.

narration: Unless a search tool is attached, there is no source and no citation available.
caption: जब तक खोज का औज़ार न जुड़ा हो, कोई स्रोत और हवाला नहीं होता।
image_brief: The empty footnote area at the foot of a printed page, a ruled line drawn but nothing written below it, the page corner slightly lifted, soft lamplight.

narration: The opposite mistake is just as common. Just predicting text sounds like a dismissal.
caption: उलटी भूल भी आम है: कहना कि यह तो बस अगला शब्द बताता है।
image_brief: A small clockwork mechanism laid open on a velvet cloth, dozens of tiny gears meshed in layers, a curt handwritten tag resting beside it, focused bench light.

narration: Prediction at that scale forces real structure to appear. Dismissing it explains nothing at all.
caption: इतने पैमाने पर अंदाज़ा असली ढाँचा बनाता है। टाल देना कुछ नहीं समझाता।
image_brief: A section of honeycomb held upright against a plain background, its cells uniformly hexagonal with no template or mould nearby, warm light through the wax.

narration: Third mistake. Hearing confidence as probability. I am certain is itself predicted text. Nothing more.
caption: तीसरी भूल: भरोसे को संभावना मान लेना। वह भी गढ़ा हुआ वाक्य है।
image_brief: A bold printed phrase on a card standing in a small brass holder, the card face clean, an empty measuring gauge lying flat beside it, cool even light.
